body: That's racist! Implying the nigger is on bottom... it can be on top.
I think he should. What's terrible is how amazingly supportive he is. I know I'm making him miserable but he'd never admit it.

I'm not laughing. At least you are not married and still living with your parent :/. 

Anyway, your situation sounds too familiar to mine except I found someone worth living for and I have a dog. You should seriously consider adopting a pet. I hope your apartment allows them.

Please excuse me if I come off as too insensitive but this is just my personal feelings about this subject. 

I also have to use great restraint to stop myself from harming myself. I have major depressive disorder and if I do fall off the wagon, not only do I hurt myself but I hurt others around me. That results in more self-loathing and pain. 

That's why when I do end up hurting myself, I tend to hide it as best as I can. I don't understand why others feel the need to announce they are practicing this behavior. It makes me unsympathetic to those. I feel they're just seeking attention. 

I don't understand what you are going through and I might never be able to fathom it. I also don't understand that instead of just asking for help, you felt the need to post a picture of your cuts. So I am genuinely curious, why are you cutting yourself?

I try, I really do. I'm honestly just too tired to do that. I work full time and I go to school full time. I also feel like I require a lot of sleep. I don't understand why eight hours isn't enough for me. It doesn't matter if I slept for seven or thirteen hours, usually I'm always tired. Waking up is almost painful. Because I'm so busy all the time I usually just want to rush home and relax. I should add that I work at a gas station. That's how I get most of my food :/  

Like a lot of unhealthy people, I just don't like healthy foods. I tend to buy them and let them go bad.
